pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Dark contiguous regions on the neck and upper flank exhibit sharp edge gradients with complex polygonal and stellate geometries. Lower flank and ventral patches transition to smaller, more rounded, and fragmented spatial areas with softer pixel-level edge gradients.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: The light negative-space network is continuous with variable pixel thickness, exhibiting wider pathways on the lower neck and thinning toward the dorsal ridge. Junction nodes primarily manifest as tri-radial and quadri-radial intersections.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane along the upper neck shows a high-frequency, low-amplitude serrated 1D contour. The silhouette is composed of densely packed, vertically oriented bristly structures providing a jagged edge against the background.
